title: Aurora Sportsmen's Club
specs: Approximately 270 acres of shooting sports facilities including rifle, pistol, shotgun, and archery ranges
All persons under age 18 must have parent/guardian permission and be accompanied by an adult
Eye and hearing protection must be worn within 30 feet of active shooting positions
Members and guests with valid Illinois Concealed Carry Firearm License and law enforcement officers may carry concealed on Club property
Guests may shoot only under direct supervision of members, with up to three guests per member on the line at one time
blurb: Aurora Sportsmen's Club operates on approximately 270 acres near Waterman, Illinois. It is a private club open to members and their accompanied guests, offering rifle, pistol, shotgun, and archery shooting ranges. The club provides training, education, and youth programs related to shooting sports.
extraNote: Everyone on ASC property must follow directions given by ASC Range Officers · Intoxicating substances are not permitted on the property · During cease fire or range closing, orange safety cones must be placed down range and no one may handle uncased firearms or bows · Open year-round, no winter or holiday closures
